description: The valid codes for one dimension of one FAOSTAT domain — the country/area codes, element codes (production quantity, area harvested, yield, import value, ...), item codes (wheat, cattle, nitrogen fertiliser, ...) or years a domain actually carries. Call this BEFORE faostat_data: FAOSTAT codes are numeric and domain-specific, so guessing them returns nothing rather than an error. Example: domain "QCL" dimension "element" lists production quantity (5510), area harvested (5312) and yield (5412); domain "QCL" dimension "item" lists the crops and livestock products. Answers keylessly from a stored copy of FAO's bulk files for four domains (QCL crops and livestock production, FBS food balances 2010-, PP producer prices, RL land use), with the data date in every answer; any other domain needs `_apiKey` for FAO's account-gated live API.

_apiKey.description: Optional. A FAOSTAT access token, or "email:password" for a FAOSTAT account: sends the call live to FAO's account-gated query API (any domain). Without it the call is answered from the stored copy of QCL, FBS, PP and RL.

dimension.description: Which dimension to list: "area" (countries and territories), "areagroup" (regional aggregates), "element" (the measured quantity), "item" (the commodity), "itemsgroup" (commodity aggregates), "year", "flag" (data-quality flags) or "unit".

domain_code.description: FAOSTAT domain code from faostat_domains, e.g. "QCL".

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the code label, e.g. "wheat".

name: faostat_dimensions
title: Faostat Dimensions
